parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. <short pause> In the world ye shall have tribulation: <short pause> but be of good cheer; <short pause> I have overcome the world. <short pause> John, chapter sixteen, verse thirty-three.

Lord Jesus, the world brings trouble, but You bring peace. <short pause> You have already overcome everything that weighs on me tonight. <short pause> I take courage in Your victory and let Your peace settle over my mind and heart as I prepare for sleep. <short pause> Amen.
